title: 上部 凡尘问道 第21章 藏书阁禁书区的考验上部 凡尘问道 第22章 旧规则漏洞与罪责
content_zh:
第1节符文锁初现，排列逻辑迷
内门藏书阁矗立在道院东侧的灵脉节点上，朱红大门刻满云纹，门前两名黑衣修士气息凝练，正是**区的守门人。为首者身着玄色道袍，腰间挂着一枚青铜令牌，上面刻着“开源”二字的另一半，正是许玄的旧部柳砚（取自《诗经·秦风·小戎》“言念君子，温其如玉。在其板屋，乱我心曲”，柳为古韵姓氏，砚取文房器物意象，适配藏书阁守门人沉稳特质）。
“来者止步！”柳砚眼神锐利，扫过凌无妄，“**区非内门长老不得入内，你一个新晋内门弟子，何来胆子擅闯？”
凌无妄掏出许玄给的开源令牌，上前一步“晚辈凌无妄，受许玄前辈所托，前来**区寻找原初灵气。”
柳砚看到令牌，眼神微动，接过令牌与自己腰间的半块拼接，严丝合缝，令牌瞬间爆发出淡金色光芒。他脸色缓和了几分“果然是许玄师兄的令牌，但**区有三层规则考验，需凭自身能力破解，我不能相助。”
他抬手一挥，朱红大门缓缓打开，露出里面的通道，通道尽头是一面刻满符文的石壁“这是第一层考验‘符文排列’，石壁上的符文杂乱无章，需在一炷香内按正确逻辑排列，否则通道会自动封闭，且触发道院警报。”
凌无妄走进通道，大门在身后关闭，通道内弥漫着淡淡的墨香，石壁上的符文闪烁着青色光芒，共计三十六枚，杂乱地分布在石壁上，看似毫无规律。
【检测到第一层考验符文排列逻辑。符文源自原初天道基础规则，核心逻辑为“阴阳相生，五行循环”。规则之眼解析效率80%。警告符文每30秒会随机变换位置，增加破解难度】
“一炷香，也就是半个时辰，时间紧迫。”凌无妄深吸一口气，运转规则之眼，开始解析符文。
符文分为五种颜色，分别对应金木水火土五行，每种颜色有七枚，唯独黑色符文有一枚，显然是核心符文。凌无妄发现，每枚符文上都刻着细微的纹路，纹路的走向暗示着排列顺序。
“五行循环，阴阳相生，黑色核心符文应在中央，五行符文围绕核心排列。”凌无妄心中有了初步判断，伸手触碰一枚青色符文（对应木属性），想要将其移到东方位置。
但就在他触碰符文的瞬间，所有符文突然闪烁，位置发生了变化，原本的排列逻辑被打乱。凌无妄心中一凛，没想到符文会主动变换位置。
【检测到符文防御机制触碰错误符文将触发位置重置，剩余重置次数3次。若重置次数耗尽，考验失败】
“不能盲目触碰！”凌无妄收敛心神，规则之眼全力运转，捕捉符文纹路的细微变化。他发现，无论符文如何变换位置，纹路的走向始终指向一个固定的方向，那就是五行对应的方位。
木属东方，火属南方，金属西方，水属北方，土属中央，而黑色核心符文则对应阴阳平衡，需放在五行符文的交汇处。
凌无妄不再犹豫，按照规则之眼解析的逻辑，快速移动符文。他先将黑色核心符文移到中央，再依次将五行符文按方位排列，每移动一枚符文，都精准对应纹路指向的位置。
当最后一枚金色符文（对应金属性）移到西方位置时，石壁突然震动，符文发出耀眼的光芒，形成一个完整的五行阵法，第一层考验成功破解。
通道前方的石门缓缓打开，柳砚的声音传来“不错，第一层考验通过，但接下来的第二层，难度会翻倍，你好自为之。”
凌无妄走进石门，心中明白，真正的考验才刚刚开始。
第2节能量感应关，阈值精准控

第二层通道比第一层更为狭窄，两侧墙壁上镶嵌着数十颗夜明珠，照亮了前方的平台。平台中央有一个圆形凹槽，凹槽内漂浮着一缕淡白色的灵气，正是原初灵气的微弱波动。
“第二层考验‘能量感应阈值’。”柳砚的声音从石壁后传来，“凹槽内的原初灵气有固定的能量阈值，你需将自身灵力注入凹槽，精准匹配阈值，误差不得超过千分之一，否则将触发能量爆炸，通道会被炸毁。”
凌无妄走到平台前，看着凹槽内的原初灵气，规则之眼瞬间解析【检测到原初灵气能量阈值10000标准单位。主角当前可调动灵力12358标准单位。需精准压缩灵力至阈值，误差≤0001】
“千分之一的误差，这也太苛刻了！”凌无妄心中暗惊。他当前的灵力远超阈值，需要精准压缩，但灵力压缩本身就存在损耗，想要控制在千分之一的误差内，难度极大。
他运转开源心法，尝试压缩灵力。但刚一压缩，灵力就出现了波动，显示为9876标准单位，低于阈值。他调整力度，再次压缩，灵力又飙升至10123标准单位，超出了阈值。
【检测到灵力压缩误差-0124（第一次），+0123（第二次）。警告连续三次误差超过阈值，将触发能量爆炸】
凌无妄额头渗出冷汗，他知道不能再盲目尝试。规则之眼运转，分析灵力压缩的规律，发现开源心法的灵力流动存在细微的波动，正是这种波动导致压缩不准确。
“必须修正开源心法的灵力流动轨迹，让其保持稳定。”凌无妄心中念头一动，规则之眼快速捕捉灵力波动的规律，调整心法运行路线，剔除冗余的波动节点。
经过多次调整，凌无妄再次尝试压缩灵力。这一次，他屏气凝神，将修正后的开源心法运转到极致，灵力在指尖凝聚成一缕细线，缓缓注入凹槽。
content_en:
Section 1 The rune lock appears for the first time, and the arrangement logic is confusing
The inner gate library stands on the spiritual node on the east side of the Taoist temple. The vermilion door is engraved with cloud patterns. The two monks in black in front of the door have a condensed aura, and they are the gatekeepers of the ** area. The leader is wearing a black Taoist robe, with a bronze token hanging around his waist. The other half of the word "Kaiyuan" is engraved on it, which is Liu Yan, Xu Xuan's former subordinate (taken from "The Book of Songs, Qin Feng, Xiao Rong", "The words and thoughts of a gentleman are as gentle as jade. In his wooden house, my heart sings." Liu is an ancient surname, and the inkstone takes the image of the study utensils, which suits the calm character of the gatekeeper of the library).
"Stop whoever comes!" Liu Yan glanced at Ling Wuwang with sharp eyes, "No one except the elders of the inner sect is allowed to enter the ** area. How can you, a newly promoted inner sect disciple, have the courage to trespass?"
Ling Wuwu took out the open source token given by Xu Xuan and stepped forward, "Junior Ling Wuwang, entrusted by senior Xu Xuan, came to the ** area to find the original spiritual energy."
When Liu Yan saw the token, his eyes moved slightly. He took the token and spliced it with the half piece around his waist. They fit perfectly, and the token instantly burst into light golden light. His expression softened a bit, "It is indeed Senior Brother Xu Xuan's token, but there are three levels of rule tests in the ** area. You need to rely on your own ability to crack it. I can't help."
He raised his hand and waved, and the vermilion door slowly opened, revealing the passage inside. At the end of the passage was a stone wall engraved with runes. "This is the first level of test 'rune arrangement'. The runes on the stone wall are messy and need to be arranged according to correct logic within a stick of incense, otherwise the passage will be automatically closed and the Taoist alarm will be triggered."
Ling Wuwang walked into the passage, and the door closed behind him. The passage was filled with the faint fragrance of ink, and the runes on the stone wall shone with cyan light. There were thirty-six runes in total, scattered randomly on the stone wall, seemingly without any order.
[The first level of test rune arrangement logic is detected. The runes are derived from the basic rules of the original way of heaven, and the core logic is "Yin and Yang complement each other, and the five elements cycle". The eye of rules analysis efficiency is 80%. The warning rune will randomly change its position every 30 seconds, making it more difficult to crack]
"One stick of incense only lasts half an hour. Time is running out." Ling Wuwang took a deep breath, turned his eyes of rules, and began to analyze the runes.
The runes are divided into five colors, corresponding to the five elements of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth. There are seven of each color, except for one black rune, which is obviously the core rune. Ling Wuwang discovered that each rune was engraved with subtle lines, and the direction of the lines hinted at the order of arrangement.
"The five elements cycle, yin and yang complement each other, the black core rune should be in the center, and the five elements runes should be arranged around the core." Ling Wuwang made a preliminary judgment in his mind, and reached out to touch a cyan rune (corresponding to the wood attribute), wanting to move it to the east.
But the moment he touched the runes, all the runes suddenly flashed, their positions changed, and the original arrangement logic was disrupted. Ling Wuwang's heart trembled because he didn't expect the rune to change its position on its own initiative.
[If the rune defense mechanism is detected and the wrong rune is touched, the position will be reset, and the remaining reset times are 3 times. If the number of resets is exhausted, the test fails]
"Don't touch it blindly!" Ling Wuwu restrained his mind and used his eyes of rules to operate at full strength, capturing the subtle changes in the rune patterns. He found that no matter how the runes changed positions, the lines always pointed in a fixed direction, which was the direction corresponding to the five elements.
Wood belongs to the east, fire belongs to the south, metal belongs to the west, water belongs to the north, and earth belongs to the center. The black core runes correspond to the balance of yin and yang and need to be placed at the intersection of the five elements of runes.
Ling Wuwang no longer hesitated and quickly moved the runes according to the logic analyzed by the Eye of Rules. He first moved the black core runes to the center, and then arranged the five rows of runes in order. Each rune moved accurately corresponded to the position pointed by the lines.
When the last golden rune (corresponding to metallicity) moved to the west position, the stone wall suddenly shook, and the rune emitted a dazzling light, forming a complete five-element formation. The first layer of the test was successfully cracked..
The stone door in front of the passage slowly opened, and Liu Yan's voice came out, "Yes, I passed the first level test, but the difficulty of the second level will be doubled, so you have to take care of yourself."
Ling Wuwang walked into the stone gate, knowing in his heart that the real test had just begun.
Section 2 energy sensor switch off, precise threshold control
The passage on the second level is narrower than the first level, and the walls on both sides are inlaid with dozens of luminous pearls, illuminating the platform in front. There is a circular groove in the center of the platform, and a ray of pale white spiritual energy floats in the groove, which is the weak fluctuation of the original spiritual energy.
"The second level tests the 'energy sensing threshold'." Liu Yan's voice came from behind the stone wall. "The original spiritual energy in the groove has a fixed energy threshold. You need to inject your own spiritual power into the groove and accurately match the threshold. The error must not exceed one thousandth, otherwise an energy explosion will be triggered and the channel will be blown up."
Ling Wuwang walked to the platform and looked at the original aura in the groove. The Eye of Rules instantly analyzed [the energy threshold of the original aura detected was 10,000 standard units. The protagonist can currently mobilize 12358 standard units of spiritual power. The spiritual power needs to be accurately compressed to the threshold, the error is ≤0001]
"An error of one thousandth is too harsh!" Ling Wuwu was secretly shocked. His current spiritual power far exceeds the threshold and requires precise compression. However, the compression of spiritual power itself has losses, and it is extremely difficult to control it within an error of one thousandth.
He used the Kaiyuan Mind Method to try to compress his spiritual power. But as soon as it was compressed, the spiritual power fluctuated, showing 9876 standard units, which was lower than the threshold. He adjusted the strength and compressed again, and his spiritual power soared to 10123 standard units, exceeding the threshold.
[Spiritual power compression error detected -0124 (first time), +0123 (second time). Warning: If the error exceeds the threshold three times in a row, an energy explosion will be triggered]
Cold sweat broke out on Ling Wuwang's forehead, and he knew he couldn't blindly try again. The Eye of Rules operates, analyzes the rules of spiritual power compression, and finds that there are subtle fluctuations in the flow of spiritual power in the Kaiyuan Heart Method. It is this fluctuation that leads to inaccurate compression.
"It is necessary to correct the flow trajectory of the spiritual power of the Kaiyuan Mental Technique to keep it stable." Ling Wuwang had a thought in his mind, and the Eye of Rules quickly captured the law of spiritual power fluctuations, adjusted the running route of the Mental Technique, and eliminated redundant fluctuation nodes.
After many adjustments, Ling Wuwang tried to compress his spiritual power again. This time, he held his breath and concentrated, operating the revised Kaiyuan Mental Technique to the extreme. The spiritual power condensed into a thin line at his fingertips and slowly poured into the groove.
